baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ارتضى من رسول ... يسلك من بين يديه ومن خلفه رصدا joins approved selection to a front-and-rear watch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Approval admits a messenger into a bounded route, and يسلك places an active watch in the intervals before and behind him. The arrangement is therefore a constructed security corridor rather than an honorific escort loosely attached to the messenger.

activation_trace.role: Approval opposed to displeasure supplies the admission decision that selects the messenger.
The messenger-and-message image makes the selected person the carrier of a dispatch.
Putting one thing into another makes the watch an intentionally emplaced element of the route.
The interval or middle gives the watch a defined spatial zone rather than an unspecified association.
The idiom of what lies before the hands fixes the forward face of the guarded zone.
Behind as the opposite of the front closes the second face of the spatial envelope.
Watching, waiting, and guarding supplies the active personnel or watch function occupying both faces.

changed_reading.before: A chosen messenger has guards in front of and behind him.
changed_reading.after: Approval opens a bounded corridor for a messenger, and an active watch is deliberately placed in both intervals around him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رسول, يسلك, بين يديه, خلفه, and رصدا can be read as a dispatch moving through prepared handoffs as well as a body moving between guards.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger/message travels a path; the forward hand evokes transfer, what follows can stand in a predecessor's place, and the watch is prepared in advance. Together these images yield a chain of custody that preserves a dispatch across handoff and succession.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message remain coupled, allowing custody of the dispatch to matter alongside protection of the person.
Going through a path supplies the ordered course along which custody is maintained.
A tie between parties turns the interval into a controlled connection rather than empty distance.
Hand-to-hand transfer supplies the custody handoff at the forward edge.
One thing following and standing in another's place supplies continuity after a handoff.
Preparation and setting aside make the custodial watch preassigned rather than improvised.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a bodyguard formation around one messenger.
changed_reading.after: The formation also behaves as a prepared chain of custody, preserving a dispatched message through connection, transfer, and succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding clause defines an unseen domain hidden from eyes and denies its disclosure to anyone; إلا then opens one approved messenger-shaped exception. The front-and-rear watch can therefore be read as boundary control around a narrow disclosure aperture, not merely protection granted after information has already crossed.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as a thing uncovered to a knower establishes the disclosure domain from which the exception proceeds.
What is screened from eyes supplies the closed side of the information boundary.
Emergence and exposure supply the controlled act that the universal negative withholds.
Exhaustive negation closes disclosure to every recipient before the explicit exception.
Approval supplies the authorization condition that opens the otherwise closed boundary.
Messenger and message identify the exceptional recipient as a transmission office, not an unrestricted observer.
A lookout post or watched path turns the exception into a monitored passage.

structural_cues: 72:26 ends with a universal non-disclosure to anyone, while 72:27 begins with إلا.
من رسول narrows the admitted recipient before the front-and-rear watch is introduced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, non-disclosure, an exception, approval, and watch posts; I infer that the watch enforces the exception's boundary. A live alternative is that it protects the messenger only after disclosure rather than regulating disclosure itself.

changed_reading.before: The selected messenger receives unseen knowledge and is then escorted.
changed_reading.after: The selected messenger is a controlled aperture in a generally closed unseen domain, with the watch monitoring the passage itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, the sky is filled with guards, would-be listeners occupy listening stations, and an awaiting watch meets the present interceptor. The same رصد in the focus now surrounds the approved messenger. This contrast changes the focus formation into access control that separates authorized reception from interception and marks the message's provenance.

activation_trace.role: Preservation and guarding establish a defended upper boundary.
Sitting for surveillance or ambush makes the listening stations deliberate interception points.
Auditory reception names the access sought by the unauthorized listener.
An awaiting watch confronts attempted interception and supplies the exact repeated security function.
Approval distinguishes the admitted messenger from an unapproved listener.
Passage through a path supplies the authorized route through the defended boundary.
The same watching function now secures the admitted route around the messenger.

structural_cues: 72:9 and 72:27 repeat رصدا at the two opposed access situations.
The earlier sequence moves from filled guards to occupied listening stations to an awaiting response; the focus adds explicit approval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a blocked listening regime and an approved guarded messenger; I infer an authorized-versus-intercepted channel and a provenance function. The guards could instead be punitive in 72:9 and protective in 72:27 without forming one channel model.

changed_reading.before: The focus watch protects a favored individual from unspecified danger.
changed_reading.after: The watch distinguishes an authorized revelatory route from intercepted listening and thereby authenticates where the received message came from.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier يسلكه takes an object and depicts causing something to enter a difficult course. Repetition of the root activates the insertion branch in the focus: رصدا is not just moving beside the messenger but is actively placed into the front and rear intervals as the object of a controlled operation.

activation_trace.role: Causing one thing to enter another demonstrates the root's active insertion mechanism in a nearby construction.
The same insertion image makes the watch the element deliberately introduced into the route.
The interval supplies the receiving slots for the inserted watch.
Prepared resources make the inserted watch an assigned deployment.

structural_cues: 72:17 uses يسلكه with an overt object pronoun; 72:27 repeats the verb before accusative رصدا.
The paired prepositional intervals specify where the deployed object operates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated سلك, an overt caused entrant in 72:17, and an accusative watch with two locations in 72:27; I infer active emplacement by the governing subject. A live alternative takes يسلك in the focus primarily as conducting the watch along a route.

changed_reading.before: Guards happen to accompany the messenger on both sides.
changed_reading.after: The governing subject deliberately inserts a prepared watch into the messenger's forward and rear intervals.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following purpose clause connects the formation to knowing that messages reached their destination, then adds complete enclosure and exhaustive counting. The watch therefore functions as an end-to-end custody and audit system: it secures transfer, surrounds what the messengers hold, and makes completed delivery inspectable.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering a fact to a knower gives the guarded arrangement an explicit epistemic result.
Delivering a message supplies the operational outcome that the watch must preserve.
The message branch identifies the payload whose delivery is being established.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and seizure turns front-and-rear coverage into comprehensive oversight.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies the audit's completeness test.
Counting the enumerated supplies item-level accountability rather than general awareness.
Hand-to-hand transfer anchors the audit model in a custody handoff within the focus.
A successor standing after another extends custody past the immediate handoff.
A resource prepared for a purpose becomes the assigned control that supports verification.

structural_cues: 72:28 begins with a purpose-marked ليعلم directly after the watch arrangement.
The sequence أبلغوا, أحاط, and أحصى moves from delivery to enclosure to exhaustive accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit purpose, successful delivery, enclosure, and counting; I infer a custody-audit relation between those outcomes and the watch. An alternative is that the watch only protects delivery while the following knowledge language describes an independent divine totality.

changed_reading.before: The watch controls access to the messenger while revelation arrives.
changed_reading.after: The watch also makes the whole transmission inspectable, preserving custody until delivery is established and comprehensively accounted for.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the unseen-disclosure rule, the speaker disclaims knowledge of whether the promised event is near or assigned a term. The approved messenger exception therefore cannot mean unrestricted possession of the unseen; it is item-specific access whose scope and horizon remain set by the sender.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge and discernment are explicitly negated for the promised event's timing.
A promise bounded by an appointment identifies the undisclosed item as temporally delimited.
An endpoint or limit supplies the horizon that remains under the Lord's assignment.
Approval authorizes a particular disclosure without transferring ownership of the whole hidden domain.
Messenger status keeps the recipient functionally dependent on what is sent.
A monitored path supplies a bounded route for selected information rather than open-ended access.

structural_cues: 72:25 places لا أدري and an alternative between nearness and a divinely set term immediately before 72:26-27.
The focus says من رسول, preserving the recipient's sent and dependent role.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confessed temporal ignorance, a promised event, a set endpoint, and selective disclosure; I infer item-specific authorization rather than a permanent faculty. The live alternative is that ignorance of this timing says nothing about the breadth of other disclosures.

changed_reading.before: An approved messenger is broadly admitted to the unseen.
changed_reading.after: An approved messenger receives bounded, sender-chosen disclosures while the horizon and undisclosed remainder stay outside his possession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first presents excessive speech about God and the mistaken assumption that humans and jinn would not utter falsehood against God. Against that problem, approval plus a watched messenger/message channel becomes a provenance filter: it distinguishes authorized disclosure from speech merely attributed to God.

activation_trace.role: Saying what did not occur or attributing it supplies the counterfeit-message mechanism.
Deviation and injustice away from truth characterize the attributed speech's distortion.
Falsehood opposed to truth names the integrity failure the guarded channel answers.
Approval supplies positive authorization for the source of disclosure.
Messenger and message join source identity to the content being conveyed.
Active watching makes the authorized transmission distinguishable from unsupported attribution.

structural_cues: 72:4-5 repeatedly frame problematic speech as speech على الله.
The focus combines explicit approval, messenger status, and a watched route rather than treating every claim alike.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, deviation, approval, messenger status, and watching; I infer a message-authentication function. A live alternative is that the watch controls access but does not itself evaluate the truth of later human or jinn speech.

changed_reading.before: The watch keeps hostile agents away from the messenger.
changed_reading.after: The watched, approved route also establishes provenance by separating a sent disclosure from counterfeit speech about God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The obligation of conveyance and the plural message field activate the sending root's succession-in-batches image. In the focus, hand-to-hand transfer and a follower standing in a predecessor's place allow front and rear to acquire a secondary temporal dimension: prepared watches preserve custody before, during, and after successive transmissions.

activation_trace.role: Conveying a message supplies the relay's required endpoint and duty.
Succession in batches activates a sequence of messages and messengers rather than one isolated delivery.
The same succession image lets the focus messenger stand within an ongoing dispatch sequence.
Hand-to-hand transfer supplies the relay's custody handoff.
A successor standing in a prior position supplies continuity after each handoff.
Prepared and assigned resources preserve the relay across its successive stages.

structural_cues: 72:23 couples بلاغا with رسالاته and رسوله, making conveyance the messenger's constrained function.
72:28 returns to plural رسالات immediately after the focus formation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conveyance, plural messages, succession, transfer, and replacement; I supply the temporal arrow that maps front and rear onto prior and subsequent custody stages. The materially live alternative keeps من بين يديه ومن خلفه entirely spatial around one messenger.

changed_reading.before: The watch is synchronized only with one messenger's physical location.
changed_reading.after: The watch can also preserve a relay across successive message handoffs, extending custody before and after the messenger's immediate position.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant mapped root's protective-barrier image inside يديه, whereas the construction ordinarily fixes a front location. It remains anchored in the exact hand expression, its paired rear, and رصدا; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary resonance of reinforcement, never as a replacement gloss for 'before him.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory for يديه places a protective-barrier branch at the forward side of the explicit front/rear watch.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant protective-barrier image gives the forward hand-zone a resonance of reinforcement.
The literal rear opposite the front prevents the barrier resonance from floating free of the verse's spatial frame.
Active guarding supplies the actual protective function that makes the distant barrier resonance coherent.

changed_reading.before: The phrase merely locates guards somewhere in front of the messenger.
changed_reading.after: The forward zone can faintly resonate as a reinforced barrier, completed by an explicit rear watch.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the sewing-thread branch of سلك is materially distant from ordinary route-entry language. It remains anchored in the repeated verb, the named intervals, and watch-post imagery; downstream prose should render it only as a threading analogy for distributed checkpoints, not as a lexical translation of يسلك.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يسلك governs a watch distributed through the intervals before and behind the messenger.

activation_trace.role: The repeated root's sewing-thread image supplies a material analogy of something drawn through a medium.
Thread used for sewing recasts emplacement as drawing a continuous watchline through the route.
Intervals provide the successive spaces through which the watchline is figuratively threaded.
Lookout posts along a path convert the material analogy into distributed checkpoints.

changed_reading.before: Two detached groups of guards stand at opposite sides.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, checkpoints are threaded through the route to form a continuous watchline around transmission.

strongest_changes: The إلا after universal non-disclosure changed the escort into a controlled aperture onto the unseen.
The repeated رصد of 72:9 changed the watch into an authorized-channel control opposed to interception.
The repeated سلك of 72:17 sharpened passive accompaniment into deliberate emplacement of a watch.
The purpose, delivery, enclosure, and counting of 72:28 changed security into an end-to-end custody audit.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained spatial security, information access, delivery verification, and temporal custody at once. Split-root reinforcement and sewing-thread imagery produced two contained material resonances without displacing the ordinary syntax.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether يسلك in the focus is best parsed primarily as inserting رصدا or conducting it along a route.
Whether front and rear carry any temporal custody dimension beyond their plain spatial force.
How much of the watch's work is protection, access control, provenance authentication, or manifested verification; the packet allows these functions to coexist.
